item.text: I found two specification conflicts in the checked-in tests: the README says standard shipping is R$15 (the test expects R$20), and loyalty explicitly has no settled welcome-bonus rule while two tests demand different results for the identical `100.00` input. I’ll bring those tests back in line with the documented contract and keep the implementation deterministic. The other failures are real implementation bugs.

item.text:
`mvn test` passes: 16 tests, 0 failures.

Fixed coupon expiry handling, 1-based pagination, half-up discount rounding, and free shipping at the inclusive threshold. I also corrected the shipping and loyalty tests to match the README: standard shipping is R$15, and no welcome bonus is defined. The original loyalty tests expected both 10 and 15 points for the same input, which the method cannot distinguish.

`git diff --check` passes.
